swarm_logic.independence_boundary: All reviewer roles were executed as role-separated critique by one ChatGPT organ. They are not independent experimental replications and add no evidence credit by mere agreement.

round_1.candidate: Build a broad 180-row evidence-scope dynamic-binding corpus over ten architecture/runtime families.
round_1.rejection: A parallel main commit c9525d30c2a0d4771017f22da773d166d6f4f18f materialized Zero-Step, S0 epoch CAS, Forge/Distillery, free-route provenance and pending-extraction rows. Reusing those families would create low-value duplicate corpus mass.
round_1.repair: Drop the overlapping runtime-state families and move this cycle onto exact Claude measurement interpretation gaps that were ingested but not yet materialized as candidate rows.

round_2.candidate: Convert eight exact measured phenomena into one SOURCE_OBSERVED row plus one matched SYNTHETIC_HARD_NEGATIVE row per family.
criticisms: Do not convert a measured local rank result into a universal model fact.
Do not let raw cosine bypass the documented centering requirement.
Do not convert interventional symbol-axis writeability into spontaneous dynamic-routing credit.
Do not infer a k=16 upper capacity limit from a raw anisotropic decline when whitened performance is 1.0 through k=16.
Do not convert within-template decoding into context invariance when cross-template transfer contradicts it.
Do not erase a nonsignificant structural null by training a static direction anyway.
Do not let aggregate alphabet quality re-admit a specifically failed atom.
Do not transfer linear float64 codec credit to unmeasured codec classes or precisions.
repairs: Bind all direct rows to exact source package, model snapshot and ABI manifest.
Use SOURCE_OBSERVED/R0/MEASURED only for package-supported measurements.
Use SYNTHETIC_HARD_NEGATIVE/R3/UNKNOWN for tempting but unsupported extrapolations.
Set canonical_truth_allowed=false and direct_effect_authority=false on every row.
Keep validation and holdout families ancestry-isolated.
Forbid cross-model transfer and avoid positive J-Space target types.

dataset.family_pairing: Each family contains one measured interpretation row and one adversarial overclaim row.

research_feedback.new_training_rule: Teach measured evidence together with its nearest plausible overclaim. This turns Claude measurement corrections into reusable anti-shortcut behavior instead of only storing prose conclusions.
research_feedback.harness_implication: Future go/Xeno evaluation should separately score (1) exact measurement reading, (2) scope-preserving interpretation, (3) rejection of nearest overclaim, and (4) transfer to held-out measurement families.
research_feedback.falsifier: If a model improves memorization of the numeric examples but still accepts matched overclaims under paraphrase or altered numbers, this curriculum has taught recall rather than epistemic scope control.
research_feedback.next_dataset_gate: Create number-perturbed isomorphic variants only from preregistered generation rules so the model must infer relations rather than memorize these eight values; keep real holdouts closed.
